results.name: Turkey
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (floor-limited): measured 7.5 (-2.8) against published 10.3. HRW (tier 3) documents coordinated raids on 12-14 Sept 2026 against 7 LGBT groups and 2 HIV-support groups, 112 arrested and 82 held under court order, under a state operation named 'My Family Is Safe'. Three evidence moves (A4, E3, EQ1 all 2->1) register only -2.8 because 22 of 40 subdimensions are already at anchor 1. State conduct dated 12-14 Sept; HRW publication dated 18 Sept; both in window.

results.name: Tenet Healthcare
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (0.0 delta): Conifer Health Solutions’ 1,037 layoffs are ANNOUNCED, NOT EXECUTED — effective date 2 November 2026, six weeks after this assessment. Not scored as a completed event. The 61-day WARN notice is bare statutory compliance and lifts nothing. The trigger was CommonSpirit Health’s own contract exit, not Tenet conduct. Firm watch date 2026-11-02.

results.name: Denmark
results.key_finding: WITHHELD (override artefact): measured 88.6 (+7.3) against published 81.3, and the entire +7.3 is the registered ASSESSOR_OVERRIDE gap, not evidence. The 8 Sept joint statement’s own verb is that 12 ministers “confirm their intention to introduce national and/or support European restrictions”, and Danish diplomats clarified Denmark will act only via an EU decision — a conditional pledge, not conduct, so no upward move. Filing a 7-point upgrade on a scoring convention would be a textbook false positive (screening rule 5). validate-indexes reports the 8.9 gap as a warning, exit 0.

results.name: Microsoft
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (-0.3, grid rounding): Netflix precedent applied. The NYT/Daily News claims (paywall bypass, stripped copyright notices) are pleaded allegations in undecided litigation, and Dr. Brent Hecht’s January 2023 memo calling AI training “the largest theft of labor in human history” is a quoted internal remark, not a finding of conduct. The tempting A5/AB2 inference — warned internally, proceeded anyway — was declined because it requires accepting the plaintiff’s contested framing.

results.name: Copenhagen
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (0.0, ceiling-limited): ATTRIBUTION. The batons were used by Københavns Politi, a district of Denmark’s single NATIONAL police service accountable to the Rigspolitiet and Ministry of Justice — not a City of Copenhagen agency. The march was a private group’s, the blockade the counter-protesters’. No municipal conduct located, so nothing moves. Calibration: the only entity in the catalogue at exactly 100.0, reached only because the formula clamps 106.25.

results.name: Russia
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (0.0, absolute floor): PENDING-PROPOSAL CHECK DONE FIRST — no pending Russia proposal exists (all 16 are applied, superseded or auto-confirm-eligible), so this corroborates rather than duplicates. 32 cruise missiles and 166 drones hit Kyiv and Odesa on 7-8 Sept, killing 5, one day after US envoys left — anchor-1 conduct on I1 and AB1, both already at 1. All 8 dimensions and all 40 subdimensions are at the floor; the score cannot fall further.

results.name: San Francisco
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (-1.3, grid rounding): ICE AND CBP ARE FEDERAL, stated explicitly. The detention room is a CBP lounge and the 72-hour limit breached is a CBP guideline. The city is the airport’s owner, and Airport Director Mike Nakornkhet stated the city and Airport Commission lack authority to regulate federal activity. City conduct located was a unanimous Board of Supervisors condemnation and a mayoral restatement of sanctuary policy. The airport merely “is considering adding signage” — a plan, so no upward move either. RISK-017 slug collision on this row reported, not fixed.

results.name: Dayton
results.key_finding: PROPOSAL FILED (-5.9, magnitude trigger): measured 30.0 against published 35.9, band unchanged (Developing). Properly attributable city conduct throughout. Dayton criminalised public food distribution without a permit for 26 years; a Dayton officer handcuffed volunteer Mitchell West on 7 April 2024 for handing a homeless man a burrito; a federal judge struck the ordinance down in June 2026; the city APPEALED, then settled for $56,365.62 covering attorney fees and costs ONLY, and “declined to comment”. Five subdimension moves: AB1 3->1, AB2 3->2, AB5 2->1, EQ4 2->1, E4 3->2. No repeal of the ordinance located.

results.name: Nasdaq
results.key_finding: WITHHELD BAND CROSSING (RISK-006): measured 60.0 (-2.5) crosses Established to Functional — but with ZERO located evidence in either direction. The crossing is produced entirely by integer-grid rounding of a uniform 3.5 seed placeholder, landing on exactly 60.0, the value where getBand() (Functional) and dimensions.ts BANDS (Established at min 60) disagree. §3f makes band crossings filable at any delta; deliberately not used here, because screening rules 3 and 5 forbid filing a band label on arithmetic alone. Referred to the RISK-006 boundary cohort and the 62.5 placeholder cohort.

results.name: Plains All American
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (-1.3, grid rounding): no in-window evidence. Historical record recorded but NOT re-scored to avoid double-counting: the DOJ settlement attributes the 2015 Line 901 rupture (~2,934 barrels near Refugio State Beach) to “Plains’ failure to address external corrosion and have adequate control-room procedures in place”; $230M class settlement (2022); $1.75M EEOC settlement (undated). All support the published Critical placement rather than contradicting it.

results.name: Czech Republic
results.key_finding: CONFIRMED (-1.9, grid rounding): no in-window evidence. Two tier-4 Council of Europe findings located but UNDATED in the available material, so recorded not scored: the European Committee of Social Rights found a breach of Article 16 of the European Social Charter on Roma access to social housing, and the Commissioner for Human Rights called for systemic change on Roma and disability rights. Both corroborate the profile’s lowest dimension (Equity 3.0). Grid rounding gives 60.6, which stays Established by 0.6 points — no RISK-006 problem, unlike Nasdaq on the same seed value.

results.name: Algeria

No source identifies any person or population harmed — no stranded nationals, no interrupted remittances, no suspended humanitarian programme, no detention, injury or death. Forcing it into a subdimension would require inventing a harmed population. No score measured, no sidecar, last_assessed NOT stamped.

incidents.title: This stage destroyed the scanner’s uncommitted rotation-state writes with an erroneous `git checkout`, then repaired them from the scan file.
incidents.what_happened: After correctly writing 12 assessor-owned field values, this stage ran `git diff --stat` and saw 2,673 changed lines. That number was misread as evidence that JSON.stringify had reformatted the whole file, and `git checkout research/rotation-state.json` was run to revert. The diff was in fact legitimate: it was the scanner’s own 2,658 uncommitted lines (1,329 last_scanned + 1,329 last_evidence_touch) plus this stage’s 12 and meta.last_scan. The checkout therefore discarded the entire 2026-09-18 scanner write, resetting all 1,329 entities to last_scanned/last_evidence_touch 2026-09-17 and meta.last_scan to 2026-09-17.
incidents.why_it_matters: rotation-state is the staleness baseline for all 1,329 tracked entities. Left reverted, the next cycle would have believed no entity was scanned on 2026-09-18 and would have re-scanned the whole catalogue against a stale baseline.
incidents.repair: Deterministically reconstructed, not guessed. research/scans/2026-09-18.json records reviewed_at 2026-09-18 for all 1,329 entity_reviews, and overnight-scanner.md step 8 specifies that the scanner sets last_scanned and last_evidence_touch to the cycle date for every reviewed entity — confirmed by the committed HEAD state, in which all 1,329 carried 2026-09-17 uniformly from the previous cycle. All 1,329 were restored to 2026-09-18 on both fields and meta.last_scan set to 2026-09-18. A byte-identical JSON.stringify(j, null, 2) round-trip of the file was verified before writing, so no reformatting occurred.
incidents.verification: git diff -U0 on research/rotation-state.json shows exactly 5 distinct keys changed and nothing else: last_scanned (1,329), last_evidence_touch (1,329), meta.last_scan (1), last_assessed (11), last_change_proposal (1). No composite, band or rank line appears in the diff.
incidents.rule_note: last_scanned, last_evidence_touch and meta.last_scan are scanner-owned fields that this stage is normally forbidden to write. They were written here solely as repair of damage this stage caused, and the repair is disclosed rather than silent. If the coordinator prefers, the correct alternative is to re-run the scanner’s rotation-state write step; the reconstructed values should be identical.

math_hygiene: ONE KNOWN, REGISTERED DIVERGENCE, NO NEW DEFECT. computeCompositeFromDimensions reproduces the published composite exactly (diff 0.0) for 14 of the 15 entities in scope: Turkey 10.3, Tenet Healthcare 31.9, Microsoft 65.3, Copenhagen 100, Russia 0, San Francisco 46.9, Dayton 35.9, Nasdaq 62.5, Plains All American 18.8, Czech Republic 62.5, Algeria 11.2, Unitree Robotics 35.9, Rethink Robotics 60.9, Sanctuary AI 81.4. The exception is Denmark: published 81.3 against formula 90.2, diff 8.9. Denmark is in the registered ASSESSOR_OVERRIDE_NAMES set, validate-indexes.mjs reports it as a warning rather than an error, and the validator exits 0 — so per the assessor rule this is not a new math-hygiene issue. It is nonetheless the single largest override gap encountered and is escalated as a calibration item, because it makes any mechanical re-measurement of Denmark read as a ~7-point upgrade with no evidence behind it.
calibration_referrals: RISK-006 band-boundary cohort (NEW, urgent): Nasdaq’s integer-grid rounding lands on exactly 60.0, where getBand() in scoring.mjs says Functional and BANDS in dimensions.ts — declared the single source of truth — says Established (min 60). Every uniform-3.5 / 62.5 placeholder in the catalogue will land on this same value when de-seeded. The boundary must be fixed in the methodology BEFORE the 62.5 clusters are de-seeded, exactly as RISK-006’s recommended mitigation says.

62.5 placeholder cohort: Nasdaq (fortune-500, rounds to 60.0) and Czech Republic (countries, rounds to 60.6). Study with Harmonic Bionics (2026-09-17), Chile, France, Slovenia, Netflix and Bridgetown.

35.9 placeholder cohort (NEW): Dayton (us-cities) and Unitree Robotics (robotics-labs) carry an identical published composite of 35.9 AND a byte-identical dimension vector (all 2.5 with Equity 2.0) across two different indexes. Dayton’s proposal is conduct-backed and does not rely on this; the shared placeholder itself needs study.

Assessor-override cohort (NEW): Denmark’s published 81.3 sits 8.9 points below its own formula value of 90.2. The 2026-04-25 proposal that set it records dimension scores but not the composite arithmetic, so the derivation of 81.3 cannot be reproduced from the record. Other ASSESSOR_OVERRIDE_NAMES entities should be checked for the same condition; Abbott’s gap is only 0.6 and Turkey’s and Microsoft’s are 0.0.

Ceiling-artifact cohort (NEW): Copenhagen is the only entity in the catalogue published at exactly 100.0, and reaches it only because the canonical formula clamps a raw 106.25. A ceiling with no headroom can register neither improvement nor decline. Note the denmark-2026-04-25 proposal already described composite-100 as a “countries-ceiling artifact”.

Floor-saturation cohort: Turkey (22 of 40 subdimensions at anchor 1) and Russia (40 of 40 at anchor 1, composite 0.0). Genuinely new atrocity-class conduct cannot register on either row. Carried alongside the standing Bolivia Critical-band calibration flag.
attribution_findings: Three of tonight’s ten flags turned on attribution, and all three were resolved against attributing third-party conduct to the scored entity: San Francisco (ICE and CBP are federal; the city is only the airport’s owner and says it cannot regulate federal activity), Copenhagen (Københavns Politi is a district of Denmark’s national police service, not a municipal force) and Tenet Healthcare (the contract exit was CommonSpirit Health’s decision). Dayton is the deliberate contrast: every scored act — ordinance, arresting officer, appeal, settlement — is the city’s own, and it is the only proposal filed.
